query:
SELECT
                ((ts - ?1) / ?2)           AS "bucket!: i64",
                COALESCE(SUM(bytes), 0)    AS "bytes!: i64"
            FROM activity_log
            WHERE ts >= ?1 AND event_type = 'upload_done'
            GROUP BY ((ts - ?1) / ?2)
            ORDER BY ((ts - ?1) / ?2) ASC
